source_criterion:
# Unrun ordinary reference-taking batch controller

This is one scratch-only source discriminator, not a selected implementation.
It serves the remaining Vector controller question and is removed after its
owning experiment retains reproducible evidence. No compiler, library, API,
accepted verdict, production source or native adapter changes. No source check,
compilation, link, execution or timing has run for it.

The exact baseline, candidate and patch are in this directory; `inputs.json`
pins source/compiler 7abd. The complete original archive remains read-only in
the source-controller scratch directory. Before an authorized compilation,
extract that archive to a separate snapshot and apply this one patch; never
read moving worktree modules or overwrite the rejected candidate's snapshot.

## Alias relation and scope of the proposal

The original tail call receives `&values` and `&digest`, two distinct local
roots. Its exact write row reaches the vector's storage through the first
reference and the digest through the second. EFF-5 checks their separation;
reference escape is forbidden. The existing ordinary backend consequently
marks each reference parameter `noalias nonnull captures(none) dereferenceable(8)`.
LLVM's inliner supplies the two dynamic helper scopes visible as !15/!17 in
control.opt.ll, in addition to the nested append/truncate scopes. The owner
pointer slot and the digest cell are separate, and backing payload accesses
in the inlined body carry the corresponding !noalias lists. This is an
observed conversion of accepted parameter facts, not a new assertion that
arbitrary subfields or two entries of one parameter are disjoint.

Direct source expansion eliminates the helper boundary. It retains each public
operation's ordinary scopes, but no longer has that enclosing pair. The observed
backing-pointer/length outer PHIs become per-cycle loads plus an owner-slot
store. Code inspection has not isolated whether that metadata difference or
other inlining/loop-promotion ordering caused the change.

The new helper moves the whole cycles loop across one ordinary reference
boundary. `values` remains a checked reference parameter for the batch; digest
storage is constructed fresh inside each cycle and remains local. Thus this
proposal does not claim to recreate both old scopes exactly. It asks whether
ordinary source decomposition recovers the useful promotion using existing
facts. It is not a compiler missing-fact repair, a per-access scope emitter,
an inliner policy or a new alias promise. Batch operations over mutable generic
state routinely keep setup and repeated operations together under one call;
the same decomposition applies beyond this benchmark to preallocated batches
and bounded repeated transformations. It branches on neither payload type nor
selected count.

## Exact work and prospective code criterion

Move the already reviewed expanded cycles block into the private generic
`vector_library_suffix_cycles`. Parameter substitution changes `values` to a
reference formal; checksum enters by value and returns by value. Preserve all
wrapping arithmetic, constructor/append/truncate/accept order, fresh per-cycle
digest, unconditional zero-removal truncate, prefix contents, final drain/free
and zero-round result. Leave reserve/prefix/final drain and other trace branches
at their original sites. Keep the old tail helper declaration initially. The
source patch has no production destination until a future selection.

Require independent source-equivalence inspection before compiling. With the
same frozen CLI and ordinary O3 consumer, require outer pointer/length promotion
(or equivalent native register transport) without the rejected candidate's
extra per-cycle owner-slot store/reloads. Wide constant preparation must remain
outside the repeated cycle, one-record SIMD/direct backing stores must remain,
and there must be no owner-sized snapshot, new per-cycle helper call or repeated
wide tail frame/setup. A once-per-trace batch call is allowed and its setup,
frames, spills and caller costs must be inventoried. Compare all emitted and
linked bodies and unchanged branches, not static instruction totals alone.
Failure of those conditions stops before correctness or timing.

The earlier tail-only wide suffix-2/count-16 loss and the direct composition's
three scalar suffix-3 losses remain explicit falsifiers. Native structural
success alone selects nothing. Any separately authorized continuation retains
all four full correctness images, faults and 294-row ledger equality, then all
42 paired timing cells, duration/cohort qualifications, six unranked controls,
native drift and refusal of any qualified useful-cell loss. No rerun is part of
this preparation.

If separately authorized, the bounded native phase uses the frozen whitefootc
for --check and --emit-llvm, changes exactly one main name in timed LLVM, then
uses the same /usr/bin/clang -O3 -Wno-override-module -x ir commands for optimized
LLVM, assembly and an object. No compiler rebuild, flag sweep, link, correctness
matrix or timing is authorized by this file. Expected recovery of the outer
state is a prediction, not an established result.

## Authorized minimal-input refinement before compilation

Root authorized a smaller input method after reviewing the complete source
patch: use standalone frozen baseline/candidate files named vector-library.wf
in separate directories with the existing frozen CLI, whose standard library
is embedded. The first baseline --emit-llvm output must equal retained T1H0
raw LLVM byte for byte. Only that equality qualifies the minimal input method;
an unexpected difference stops the stage without normalization or changing
source/proof requirements. This replaces the proposed full-archive extraction
for this bounded screen. Both exact .wf files, compiler and control artifacts
are hashed before and after. No moving worktree library or compiler is used.

The authorized queue is PQ build/screen, then Ordered correctness/accounting,
then one guarded Vector native screen. It includes baseline reproduction,
candidate --check/--emit-llvm, exactly-one main rename, ordinary O3 optimized
LLVM/assembly/object, and read-only inventory. No linking, execution matrix or
timing is authorized. All direct statuses, full stdout/stderr and phase costs
are retained under native/. Source failure or the stated native falsifier stops
the candidate.
timing_criterion:
# One registered ordinary batch-helper timing pair

This is an equivalent caller/source decomposition trial, not a change to
GrowVector's public operations, a compiler optimization, or a promise that all
clients improve. The baseline source/compiler pin remains 7abd6bb34746b7b983b83103c68ee429b24859bb;
the frozen compiler and exact repaired source/native identities remain those in
the completed screen. Default source and all retained prior results stay separate.

Root independently reviewed the repaired source, recovered scalar outer PHIs,
wide preparation/save/reload structure and all native artifacts, then the four
full correctness images, 12 direct command statuses, fault diagnostics and
294-row ledger equality. The source preserves the exact requested workload,
ownership and constructor/append/truncate/accept order, including zero-removal
truncate, fresh per-cycle digest, zero rounds and final drain/free. No input or
source change is part of this timing phase.

The native structural prediction passed, with costs retained: scalar suffix-three
still has 71 hot-cycle instructions versus baseline 69; wide constants and seven
Q-pair saves move before the outer loop, but seven Q-pair reloads (224 bytes)
remain per nonempty cycle. The batch adds one call per suffix trace, and combined
trace/helper frames increase. Code structure alone has not repaired a timing loss.

Run exactly one control-then-candidate pair, sequentially under one shared guard:

```
${FROZEN_VECTOR_SCRATCH}/research/experiments/container-representation/vector-library/.build/actual-ablation/terminal/ecosystem/vector-costs-timed measure 1048576 7
${BATCH_CONTROLLER_SCRATCH}/continuation/candidate/vector-costs-timed measure 1048576 7
```

The existing harness retains both cohorts, all warmups, seven samples, seven
variants and all 42 cells / 4116 rows per arm. No rebuild, new arm, rerun, altered
flags, source edit, shortened duration or selective cell measurement is authorized.
Queue after the short Map native, Deque correctness and PriorityQueue correctness
phases. Verify all frozen inputs and both images immediately before and after.

Use the unchanged retained paired reducer and maintained complete/target reducer.
A qualified paired result requires disjoint observed WF ranges in the same
direction in both cohorts, every paired WF sample at least 1 ms, and at most 10%
spread between the two candidate/control median ratios. Report all 36 useful
cells, six unranked suffix-zero controls, duration/stability failures, standard
peer target statuses and native drift. Do not remove outliers or rescale WF by
native movement. Overlap or instability does not establish target completion.
Any qualified useful-cell loss rejects this candidate.

Explicit falsifiers remain the earlier tail-only forced-inline wide
suffix-two/count-16 loss and the direct-composition scalar suffix-three losses
at all three counts. Report those current cells even when overlap or unstable;
do not claim reversal from an unqualified comparison. Retain all gains and
adverse data. Root must independently reduce the samples before any production
caller selection; this one pair does not authorize adoption or another trial.
